evidence: Frozen task.toml [environment] (task/task.toml:20-24) contains only build_timeout_sec = 600.0, network_mode = "public", cpus = 2, memory_mb = 4096; there is no docker_image key. A recursive grep for 'docker_image' and 'image\s*=' across the whole frozen task/ tree returned no matches (rc=1), so no prebuilt image is declared anywhere (no [verifier.environment] or other override either; environment/ holds only Dockerfile, assets/, instructions/ - no docker-compose file). The agent Dockerfile (task/environment/Dockerfile:1-26) has active build steps: FROM node:22-bookworm-slim, apt-get install, npm install -g express@5.1.0 better-sqlite3@12.4.1, COPY instructions/ and assets/, chmod, git-init /app, WORKDIR, CMD - all of which would be skipped if docker_image were set; since it is not, they take effect. Frozen task.toml and Dockerfile are byte-identical to the template's [environment] block and Dockerfile apart from task identity fields (template rules/projects/webdev-task-template/task.toml:20-24, environment/Dockerfile:1-26). Frozen bytes match the live project: sha256 task.toml ac664d0e...8f26 and Dockerfile 0a75419e...67d1 equal in .qc-cache task and projects/hireops-recruiting-operations/hireops-recruiting-operations/. Adversarial check: a broken setup that could pass would be docker_image pointing at a stale image lacking /assets or the pinned deps while the Dockerfile looks correct - not present. A conforming alternative that could fail (docker_image set with a fully commented-out Dockerfile) is not this task's shape. The row is purely static config; no runtime build measurement is required for it, and none is claimed (no agent-image build log was inspected, so whether the Dockerfile builds is outside this row - see #15).
